title: Design System: 农险双精准地图 Demo

body.purpose: 地图操作、路径、说明与状态的稳定桌面阅读。

control.purpose: 按钮、工具条、面包屑与普通状态。

metric.purpose: 地块数量、面积与批次统计；与 tabular-nums 搭配。

shadows.name: tool-panel
shadows.purpose: 地图边缘的面包屑、工具条与控制栈。

shadows.name: status-card
shadows.purpose: 持续展示但优先级较低的统计和图例。

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: 中断地图操作的确认对话框。

shadows.name: typhoon-panel
shadows.purpose: 台风路径面板与悬浮浮窗。

shadows.name: notice
shadows.purpose: 保存成功与业务错误横幅。

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: 按钮和图标的背景、颜色及阴影状态切换。

motion.name: notice-enter
motion.purpose: 保存提示从上方轻微进入。

components.name: Primary Map Action
components.description: 提交、返回或开始核心地图操作的紧凑主按钮。
components.css: .ds-action-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #2563eb; color: #fff; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(30, 64, 175, .25); transition: background-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-action-primary:active { box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Map Action
components.description: 工具条内的次级操作，依靠悬停底色而非强色块表达。
components.css: .ds-action-secondary { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #475569; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-action-secondary:hover { background: #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a; } .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-action-secondary:active { background: #cbd5e1; }

components.name: Drawing Action
components.description: 进入或退出人工绘制时使用的紫色模式动作。
components.css: .ds-action-drawing { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #7e22ce; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-action-drawing:hover { background: #faf5ff; color: #6b21a8; } .ds-action-drawing:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(126, 34, 206, .28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Map Control Stack
components.description: 贴在地图边缘的纵向图层与缩放工具容器。
components.css: .ds-control-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: max-content; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, .34); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(248, 250, 252, .96); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, .18), 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, .12); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-control-stack button { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #475569; font: 600 18px/1 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-control-stack button:hover { background: #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a; } .ds-control-stack button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metric Status Card
components.description: 用于地块数量和面积的低干扰地图角标卡。
components.css: .ds-status-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 3px; width: max-content; padding: 9px 11px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, .34); border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(248, 250, 252, .96); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, .16), 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, .1); color: #0f172a; font-family: 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-status-card span { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: #64748b; font-size: 10px; } .ds-status-card strong { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.05; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-status-card small { color: #64748b; font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Confirmation Dialog
components.description: 放弃或确认人工地块批次操作的高优先级确认面板。
components.html:
!
确认放弃修改？

未保存的地块将被移除。
components.css: .ds-dialog { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr; gap: 14px; width: min(420px, 100%); padding: 20px; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 22px 50px rgba(15, 23, 42, .3); color: #0f172a; font: 13px/1.65 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 12px; background: #faf5ff; color: #9333ea; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-dialog strong { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: #475569; } .ds-dialog-actions { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-dialog-actions button { height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; font: 650 13px 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-actions button:last-child { background: #7e22ce; color: #fff; } .ds-dialog-actions button:hover { background: #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a; } .ds-dialog-actions button:last-child:hover { background: #6b21a8; color: #fff; }

components.name: Typhoon Path Panel
components.description: 台风实时/历史列表的蓝边框专题面板。
components.css: .ds-typhoon-panel { width: 390px; max-width: calc(100% - 24px); box-sizing: border-box; border: 5px solid #2563eb; border-radius: 10px; background: #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 7px 22px rgba(15,23,42,.24); color: #0f172a; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif; } .ds-typhoon-panel header { height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 5px 0 7px; color: #fff; } .ds-typhoon-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; } .ds-typhoon-panel header button { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: #bfdbfe; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-typhoon-panel header button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.16); color: #fff; } .ds-typhoon-panel header button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tp-cards { display: grid; gap: 7px; padding: 5px; background: #fff; } .ds-tp-cards article { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 7px; border-radius: 7px; } .ds-tp-cards strong { color: #475569; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tp-cards span { color: #64748b; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Weather Marker
components.description: 默认天气点标记，Ctrl 临时点换紫边。
components.css: .ds-weather-marker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; width: 72px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid rgba(37,99,235,.45); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(248,250,252,.97); box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.24); color: #0f172a; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-weather-marker i { font-size: 19px; } .ds-weather-marker strong { font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-weather-marker.picked { border-color: #7e22ce; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(126,34,206,.2), 0 5px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.24); } .ds-weather-marker.error { border-color: #b91c1c; background: #fff7ed; color: #991b1b; } .ds-weather-marker:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: National Alarm Panel
components.description: NMC 浙江预警的固定高度列表面板。
components.html:
气象预警

数据时间：2026/08/04 10:00

数据来源：中央气象台（NMC）
components.css: .ds-alarm-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 360px; height: 520px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.34); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(248,250,252,.96); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.18), 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.12); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: #0f172a; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif; } .ds-alarm-panel header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; } .ds-alarm-panel h2, .ds-alarm-panel p { margin: 0; } .ds-alarm-panel h2 { font-size: 16px; } .ds-alarm-panel header p { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; } .ds-alarm-panel header button { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #475569; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-alarm-panel header button:hover { background: #e2e8f0; } .ds-alarm-records { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 6px; } .ds-alarm-records button { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 6px; align-items: center; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #334155; text-align: left; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-alarm-records button:hover, .ds-alarm-records button.selected { border-color: #93c5fd; background: #eff6ff; } .ds-alarm-records img { width: 20px; height: 20px; object-fit: contain; } .ds-alarm-panel footer { padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; }

components.name: Policy Chip
components.description: 保单类型的全圆角 chip，三种语义色。
components.html: 大额保单团体保单未投保
components.css: .ds-policy-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-policy-chip.large { border-color: #86efac; background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; } .ds-policy-chip.group { border-color: #c4b5fd; background: #f3e8ff; color: #6d28d9; } .ds-policy-chip.uninsured { border-color: #cbd5e1; background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; }

components.name: Timeline Label
components.description: 台风时间轴的月份胶囊标签。
components.css: .ds-timeline-label { display: inline-block; padding: 0 7px; height: 27px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #3b82f6; color: #fff; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 27px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-timeline-label:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-timeline-label.opened { background: #1e40af; } .ds-timeline-label.focused { border: 2px solid #fbbf24; background: #1d4ed8; line-height: 23px; } .ds-timeline-label.disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background: #94a3b8; } .ds-timeline-label:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37,99,235,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
这是一个以地图为主角的内部技术验证工作台。空间影像、行政边界、地块几何与台风路径是视觉主体；界面只以轻量、半透明的控制浮层停靠在地图边缘，不抢占地图的注意力。信息密度紧凑，但每个动作、状态与反馈都必须能快速扫读。

主操作以蓝色建立单一行动路径；地块绘制以紫色形成与查看、筛选明确分离的工作模式；台风以蓝边框面板营造专题态势的沉浸感；预警等级色、风圈色与状态色保持各自稳定的语义。桌面是主使用场景，窄视口时工具条保留触达性并允许横向滚动。
keyCharacteristics: 地图优先：UI 贴边悬浮，避免占据中心视野。
轻量层次：雾白面板、细边界与柔和阴影共同区分工具层。
操作可辨：蓝色用于提交与导航，紫色用于人工绘制，状态颜色不挪作装饰。
模式带边框：台风、时间轴、悬浮浮窗用蓝实线边框包裹整块，与雾白浮层形成明确模式区分。
数值可靠：计数、面积、风力、温度和状态数量使用等宽数字，避免跳动和误读。

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: 蓝色、紫色、绿/黄/红的含义在所有地图状态、工具条、通知与图例中必须保持一致；不得因美化目的互换它们。

rules.name: The Numbers Stay Still Rule
rules.body: 任何会变化的数量、面积、风力等级、温度或批次统计必须使用等宽数字；不要用动画或比例字体制造视觉跳动。

rules.name: The Edge-First Rule
rules.body: 工具和状态信息固定在地图边缘；只有短时通知与对话框可以进入中心区域。

dos: 让地图、边界和地块始终是最大面积的视觉主体，工具仅贴边出现。
使用行动蓝表达主操作和可回跳导航，并保留悬停、禁用与键盘焦点状态。
让人工绘制始终使用绘制紫，让图例、顶点、工具条与提示保持同步。
用蓝色实线边框包裹专题模式（台风面板、时间轴、悬浮浮窗），与雾白浮层明确区分。
将状态颜色与明确文字、图标或线型一起使用，尤其是隐藏、恢复、失败与警告。
保持浮层紧凑、半透明、可读，并在窄屏保留操作触达性。
donts: 用大标题、营销式横幅、装饰性渐变或全屏卡片压过地图画布。
把蓝色、紫色或状态色当作可互换的装饰色。
将地块统计、图例和图层控制散落在中心地图区域。
只靠颜色区分地块或台风状态，或在状态计数中使用比例数字。
为追求玻璃感牺牲文字对比度或让面板不透明到遮蔽空间信息。
在台风与天气/预警之间引入第二套品牌蓝，破坏模式间的同一性。
